task: MR1 Core unit 1 Pro-only Team Chat deny stale Alap entitlement rows while preserving core customer email issue 1186

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Privilege to internal staff chat must be fail-closed at the server-owned tenant plan boundary even when an older DB entitlement row is positive. In scope is only the effective central access decision and plan catalog, not entire workspace or stored grants.

acceptanceCriteria: Alap Team Chat absent from plan catalog; Pro Team Chat present; standard customer email and support preserved in Alap.
Effective entitlement resolver compares strict workspace capability against the actual persisted instance subscription plan, denying Alap before candidate precedence can grant access.
Pro entitlement policy still honors explicit revoked/manual/trial/platform source semantics and expiry.
Targeted tests plus Edit-Time Reference Sync, Knowledge, Replay, risk and all exact-head GitHub CI gates pass.
Scope truth explicitly remains PARTIAL for #1186 until SQL migration, UI/API and operation closure.
invariants: Server authorization uses actual current instance plan, not mutable client metadata or a stale UI badge.
Plan-based non-workspace features and transactional email remain functional for Alap.
No extra source-of-truth or substitute entitlement engine.
Invalid instance/subscription data fail closed, never silently upgrade to Pro.
forbiddenStates: Alap with stale manual or platform teamChat grant receives enabled=true.
Pro lost teamChat through accidental removal from both catalog lists.
officeCommunication is removed from Alap and transactional customer email is broken.
All Digital Office backend and UI access is claimed complete after this single policy edit.

failureModes: Persisted Alap plan grant still has enabled=true and current resolver trusts it unconditionally.
An Alap trial/manual/platform override wins over the plan and incorrectly enables internal chat.
An invalid current plan or missing tenant organization falls back to Pro.
Plan change during request is not transactional with entitlement read; require fresh plan on next authorization.
Scope claims broader coverage than actual code proves.
edgeCases: Alap with valid grant from each source plan, trial, manual, platform.
Alap with positive organization-scoped row and expired instance-specific deny.
Pro tenant with manual explicit revocation.
Missing tenant, unknown feature, invalid subscription plan and expired grant.
Existing Alap core officeCommunication and support remain allowed while teamChat is not.

alternatives.summary: Use one central catalog and effective entitlement resolver to deny Pro-only internal chat on Alap, independent of stale positive DB rows.
alternatives.reason: Minimal high-risk server authority update, preserves email, matches the existing runtime used by Digital Office.

alternatives.summary: Delete Alap grants via SQL without changing effective resolver.
alternatives.reason: Future override/trial/manual records could still re-enable chat.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing centralized plan catalog and server-only entitlement batch resolver already serve shared Digital Office access, so no new service is needed.
specialistReviews.resolution: Enforce strict plan eligibility at that resolver with one exported catalog predicate.

specialistReviews.finding: Changing only ALAP_FEATURES does not deny stale positive feature_entitlements rows, including high-precedence platform/manual/trial grants.
specialistReviews.resolution: Read instance subscription_plan server-side and refuse strict Pro chat before applying entitlement candidates; record persistence reconciliation as a separate mandatory dependency.

specialistReviews.finding: A complete workspace patch mixed with SQL and admin UI exceeds this single high-risk release unit.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep strict policy code and tests in this unit; SQL synchronization and admin entrypoints follow separate verified release units.

specialistReviews.finding: Old plan tests assert Team Chat enabled in Alap and are inadequate to catch stale overrides.
specialistReviews.resolution: Update package tests and a server source contract test while retaining existing precedence and email regression.

challenge.scenario: Alap with plan source positive Team Chat row
challenge.finding: Historical DB v4 sync still grants teamChat
challenge.resolution: Return explicit disabled decision before candidate resolution

challenge.scenario: Alap with manual positive Team Chat override
challenge.finding: Higher precedence could bypass static package features
challenge.resolution: Strict product plan boundary wins over generic overrides

challenge.scenario: Alap with platform positive Team Chat override
challenge.finding: Platform override could defeat Pro-only workspace rule
challenge.resolution: Do not grant without actual Pro subscription; log future exception policy requirement

challenge.finding: Central guard could accidentally force enabled on Pro
challenge.resolution: Leave Pro paths to existing priority and revocation resolver

challenge.finding: Overbroad Digital Office restriction could block standard email
challenge.resolution: Keep officeCommunication and support catalog features unchanged

challenge.scenario: A tenant lookup returns an instance with missing organization identity or an unknown subscription plan.
challenge.finding: An unsafe fallback could treat unresolvable tenant context as Pro and grant internal chat.
challenge.resolution: Preserve the existing null decision when organization is missing, and deny restricted chat unless the server-fetched subscription_plan is exactly pro.

challenge.scenario: Subscription downgraded Pro to Alap with old positive rows
challenge.finding: Stale database permissions could survive downgrade
challenge.resolution: Check latest instance plan before interpreting row

challenge.scenario: Accidental claim of full Core closure
challenge.finding: SQL/UI/API not touched by this unit
challenge.resolution: Keep #1186 OPEN and report only strict effective chat denial

challenge.scenario: An existing admin IA navigation regression test expects Team Chat in the Alap menu even after the canonical package change.
challenge.finding: The previously correct test contract is now stale and makes Incremental Replay fail despite the effective entitlement boundary being stricter.
challenge.resolution: Extend the scoped regression file list and replace only the outdated Alap Team Chat expectation with false; preserve Pro visibility and all unrelated navigation assertions.

challenge.scenario: The Sentinel integrity probe evaluates CAP-AUTH proof obligations and finds GUARD-PLAN-BEFORE-CODE and GUARD-EDIT-TIME are registered for CAP-ATLAS and CAP-QUALITY only.
challenge.finding: Using plan-shape or edit-scope guards as a substitute for executed authorization behavior proof overclaims their registered capabilities, even though those separate preconditions still pass.
challenge.resolution: Bind CAP-AUTH implementation and outcome proof to the executed GUARD-QUALITY-TESTS, which explicitly supports all capabilities; retain both Plan and Edit-Time as mandatory independent system obligations without assigning them false CAP-AUTH authority.

proofPlan: Record current Alap teamChat grants in catalog and stale DB migration, and current server entitlements lack subscription plan validation.
Run Development Guard and Plan Before Code critical PASS with dissent before code editing.
Patch existing plan catalog and existing server-only entitlement resolver with fail-closed strict Pro rule; keep email unchanged.
Update existing regression suites and verify Alap/Pro/expired/override scenarios without bypassing release gates.
Run focused Vitest, Edit-Time, Reference Sync, Knowledge, Incremental Replay, risk, TypeScript and exact-head CI Truth/Lifecycle.
Keep issue #1186 PARTIAL until SQL resync, admin/API/job/worker and RLS proofs, then continue dependency chain.
Verify changed navigation fixture now expects Team Chat absent in Alap, while still present in Pro; keep admin navigation implementation unchanged.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The accepted Digital Office Pro-only product decision conflicts with the central Alap plan catalog, which grants teamChat, and with persisted entitlement rows whose source precedence may grant teamChat to Alap. All entrypoints using getFeatureEntitlementDecisions must deny such stale grants. This unit affects only the central effective Team Chat boundary; generic customer email remains Alap and full Digital Office closure is not claimed.
observableOutcomes: hasPlanFeature(alap,teamChat) is false; hasPlanFeature(pro,teamChat) is true and denial reason is pro-required.
For an Alap instance, central effective entitlement decisions deny teamChat despite valid plan, trial, manual or platform grants in the database.
Pro tenants continue to use existing source precedence, expiry, instance specificity, role checks and fail-closed unknown behavior.
officeCommunication, support and standard transactional emails stay on their existing Alap path; officeCommunicationAdvanced remains Pro-only.
No SQL migration, admin UI route, Builder or Template Factory change is claimed in this bounded first Core release.
unresolvedRisks: Legacy tenant plan sync still writes Alap teamChat rows; effective resolver must override them and a subsequent DB migration must reconcile persisted grants.

Customer inbox/workspace is still gated by officeCommunication, which is needed for Alap core email; a later Core release must separate Digital Office workspace from basic outbound email and backend APIs.
Database-level direct table access and background job paths are not proven by this bounded code-only release; remain PARTIAL.
Platform and trial entitlement rows may exist; this strict product boundary overrides them for Alap; any future approved exception must be modeled separately and audited.

in: Move teamChat from ALAP_FEATURES to PRO_FEATURES in the existing central catalog.
Add an explicit central strict Pro workspace capability predicate, with no independent package engine.

In the existing server-only effective entitlement decision batch resolver load instance subscription_plan together with organization_id and fail closed for Pro-only chat when plan is Alap, before applying legacy override candidates.
Update existing plan, Block 11 entitlement and customer email regression suites for package separation, unchanged email and stale-override denial.
Use exact-head CI, Truth/Lifecycle and Release Risk evidence.
Reconcile existing admin IA navigation regression: Alap no longer shows Team Chat while Pro continues to offer it; do not change the admin navigation implementation in this release.
out: No SQL schema or data mutation in this unit; required reconciliation is tracked as next dependency.
No whole Digital Office UI/API release; it must later be gated by a distinct Pro workspace entitlement while Alap transactional email continues.
No change to non-chat manual/trial/platform entitlement precedence, add-ons or customer basic email delivery.
Do not mark #1186 or MR1 package capability DONE without full database/API/UI/background job proof.

requirements.requirement: A stale positive grant never enables Team Chat for Alap at the central server-authoritative entitlement resolver; Pro source policy and core email remain unchanged.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No Alap positive plan/manual/trial/platform grant may enable Team Chat through the server resolver.

requirements.requirement: This Core authorization change is an isolated high-risk release and does not claim wider Digital Office completion.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: High-risk auth policy must not be mixed with unrelated medium-risk production code in one release.

notes: Bounded #1186 U01 only. Digital Office workspace remains PARTIAL; Alap normal customer email continues.
